about: Model admission under a project's policy (runners.md Resolution, DEC-0046; the open-vendor exception, DEC-0083), for ports: admittedByClasses in src/profile-rules.ts runs the cases, and so must every copy of the every-class rule a port keeps — its resolver and its doctor's usability check. A policy that names model classes admits a catalogue row when every class the row has is allowed, the descriptive open-vendor not counted, and at least one other class is there; a model the catalogue does not hold (classes null) is not admitted. A case's policy lists only admission classes: the spend-policy and grant schemas refuse open-vendor.

cases.name: an open model whose other classes the policy allows: open-vendor admits and excludes nothing
the same model without open-vendor: the same answer
an open model with a class the policy does not allow: excluded by that class, not by open-vendor
an open model whose every other class is allowed, among more allowed classes
a closed model whose every class is allowed
a closed model with a class the policy does not allow
a row whose only class is open-vendor (the schema refuses it): nothing to admit it by
a model the catalogue does not hold: no classes to check
